instruction: Draft a warning email in Thunderbird to `parent@example.com` with the subject `Gift card payment warning`, based on the FTC gift card scam guidance viewed in Microsoft Edge with Immersive Reader. Use the FTC's exact wording to state whether a government payment demand by gift card is legitimate, what to do with the gift card company, and where to report the scam. Save the draft without sending it.
gt_steps: Open the FTC gift card scam guidance page in Microsoft Edge.
Locate the guidance about government gift card payment demands.
Locate the guidance about reporting a gift card scam to the gift card company.
Locate the FTC scam reporting destination.
Set the subject to `Gift card payment warning`.
Enter a body containing the exact phrase `No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them`.
Add the exact phrase `report the gift card scam to the gift card company right away` to the body.
Save the email as a draft.

rules.subject: Gift card payment warning
body_points: No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them
report the gift card scam to the gift card company right away
